handoff.salientSummary: Resolved all 8 database, backend, App UI, and documentation scrutiny findings (VAL-FND-010/011/012/017/018/020/022/024): updated 0016 SQLite triggers and error mapping, auto-generated DO migrations in tenant-db tests, updated reservations-context TTL/cooldown constants, enforced hasProvisionedDb across reservations routes and expanded security sweeps, hid single-location picker in App Reservations layout, and aligned all 5 docs files with canonical vocabulary and 12 ADR 048 sections.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Resolved all 8 database, backend, App UI, and documentation blocking scrutiny findings: (1) updated rsv_occupancy_no_overlap_insert and rsv_occupancy_no_overlap_update in packages/tenant-db/drizzle/0016_reservations_foundation.sql to include AND o.active = 1 AND o.overbook = 0 and raise 'rsv_table_occupancies overlap', tightened rsv_holds_single_conversion to WHEN OLD.status = 'converted', regenerated apps/tenant-api/workers/migrations.generated.ts, updated local tenant DB triggers, and updated mapSqliteConstraintError in apps/tenant-api/src/lib/reservations-write.ts to match 'rsv_table_occupancies overlap' (including error.cause); (2) updated packages/tenant-db/src/reservations-schema.test.ts to generate apps/tenant-api/workers/migrations.generated.ts when absent and added tests for normal-overlaps-overbook and converted hold immutability; (3) updated apps/tenant-api/src/lib/reservations-context.ts and reservations-context.test.ts to enforce 5m (300,000 ms) fresh TTL, 24h (86,400,000 ms) stale TTL, 30s (30,000 ms) failure cooldown, 3s timeout, and redirect: 'error'; (4) enforced Boolean(org?.hasProvisionedDb) in reservations-operator.ts, reservations-public.ts, and reservations-internal.ts (returning uniform 404 { error: 'not_found' }) plus orgId and locationId checks in rsvGuard; (5) expanded apps/tenant-api/src/routes/reservations-security.test.ts to sweep every mounted operator route for tenant-api-operator and tenant-api-staffing audiences, over-long TTL (401), impersonated-write (403), unprovisioned org (404), cross-org ORG_B (403/404), and excluded locationIds (403/404); (6) updated apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reservations+/_layout.tsx to render the location selector only when locations.length > 1; (7) updated docs/permissions.md, docs/reservations-contract.md, docs/reservations-plan.md, docs/reservations.md, and docs/decisions/048-reservations-data-residency.md to match the 8 implemented permissions, 6 feature flags, migration 0025, aud: 'tenant-api-reservations-operator', token claims, Bearer INTERNAL_COMMAND_TOKEN, and all 12 ADR 048 sections.
